insights.question: As of 2024, what was the percentage of MediConn Solutions' patient interactions that required human intervention within the first 10 minutes of initial contact?
insights.answer: As of November 2024, 80% of MediConn Solutions' patient interactions required human intervention within the first 10 minutes of initial contact.

insights.answer: As of March 2025, MediConn Solutions experienced a 19% patient drop-off rate during the initial website navigation phase.

insights.question: In a 2024 market survey done by the marketing department of MediConn, what percentage of Canadians agreed that 'AI-assisted consultation could build confidence' in telehealth?
insights.answer: In April 2024, 71% of Canadians agreed that AI-assisted consultation could boost their trust and confidence in telehealth.

insights.question: What year did MediConn Solutions conduct internal research to identify AI use cases within the company?
insights.answer: MediConn Solutions conducted internal research in the year 2024 to identify AI use cases in various departments at MediConn Solutions.

insights.question: How many of MediConn Solutions' patients missed their follow-up appointments in 2024?
insights.answer: As of December 31st, 2024, 560 MediConn Solutions' patients missed their follow-up appointments in 2024.
